[u][b]Compatibility[/b][/u]:
Not compatible with mods that alter cellar map (Cellar.xnb).
Compatible with mods altering spritesheets used by cellar.

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]: (Just look at the images instead.)
[list]
[*]Repaired all broken boards and bricks. (Not trying to point fingers but someone did a terrible job... [i]*Twas Robin[/i])
[*]Added option for Squared corners
[*]Removed all clutter and pillars.
[/list]
[u][b]Config[/b][/u]:
Generated when you first load. Either edit config.json or be sane person and use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[list]
[*]Corners - Round/Square
[/list] 
You can change it anytime, just leave and enter cellar.

"[i]What have you done! Map is too empty! You removed all the pretty details![/i]" - I know, main purpose of this mod is to allow players to decorate their buildable spaces as they want whether they use furniture or machines. (FACTORY MUST GROW... I mean sorry, wrong game...)

[i]I'm planning on making this a series of mods. I'm planning to edit the cellar, greenhouse, farm buildings, and other farms. Maybe even the farmhouse interior itself (I took a look and was horrified by what a jigsaw mess it is... So maybe later). Later I will make matching banners and make this site prettier.
[/i]
If I overlooked some sprites, let me know (nature cut in half, wrong sprites, etc.).
